programme.desc: Der Witwer Seth Webster verarbeitet gerade den Tod seiner Frau und muss sich gleichzeitig um seine beiden 6-jährigen Zwillinge kümmern. Die Situation überfordert ihn vollkommen. Da taucht plötzlich die nette Mrs. Merkle auf, die ihn bald im Haushalt und bei der Kindererziehung unterstützt. Doch die zauberhafte Dame kann noch viel mehr, denn sie findet, dass so ein netter Mann wie Seth nicht allein sein sollte. Deshalb beschließt sie, ihm bei der Suche nach einer neuen Frau behilflich zu sein.

programme.title: Mrs. Miracle 2 - ein zauberhaftes Weihnachtsfest
programme.desc: Weihnachten steht vor der Tür - doch von Besinnlichkeit fehlt im Leben der Mitzwanzigerin Holly jede Spur: Sie muss sich um ihren zehnjährigen Neffen Gabe kümmern, denn ihr Bruder ist als Soldat für mehrere Monate im Auslandseinsatz. Ein kleiner Lichtblick ist da nur die Begegnung mit dem alleinstehenden Kaufhauserben Jake Finley, der von seinem Vater die Leitung der Spielwarenabteilung übertragen bekommen hat.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch vermutet, dass mehrere Rivalinnen für den Mord an einer Debütantin verantwortlich sind.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Ein Großbrand in Toronto erschwert Murdochs Ermittlungen zu den Morden an zwei jungen Frauen.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Nachdem Murdoch entdeckt, dass seine langjährige Freundin, die Privatdetektivin Freddie Pink, möglicherweise in einen Mord verwickelt ist, bei dem die Leiche fehlt, setzt er seine neueste Erfindung ein, um die Wahrheit herauszufinden.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Man rollt einen alten Mordfall wieder auf. Ein unschuldiger Mann sitzt im Gefängnis fest.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch und Ogden untersuchen den Tod eines untreuen Geschäftsmanns, der offenbar vergiftet wurde.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch untersucht den mysteriösen Tod eines Fußballers, während Brackenreid rekrutiert wird.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Eine Burleske-Tänzerin könnte mit dem Tod von Männern zu tun haben, die Lippenstiftspuren zeigen.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch und Crabtree geben vor, dass ein ermordeter Zeuge noch lebt, um seinen Mörder zu fassen.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch will den Kriminellen "Der Streuner" fassen, dessen amouröse Eskapaden in Mord münden.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch will den Kriminellen "Der Streuner" fassen, dessen amouröse Eskapaden in Mord münden.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Ein Mann wurde verhaftet, weil er zwei Bewohnern die Kehlen durchgeschnitten hat. Der Mörder, Jacob Foley, behauptet, vom Geist von James Gillies besessen zu sein, der ihn angeblich zu den beiden Verbrechen getrieben habe.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch untersucht den Tod eines Showhunds und bemerkt eine verborgene Zuneigung zu Hundebegleitern.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Zwanzig Jahre nach der Entführung eines Kindes untersucht Murdoch die Identität eines Mannes.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Als Murdoch und Ogden ihr Grundstück am Flussufer als Begräbnisstätte nutzen, um die Zersetzung von Leichen zu untersuchen, graben sie mehr aus, als sie sich vorgestellt hatten.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch entwickelt ein Elixier, das jugendliche Vitalität zurückbringt. Crabtree beunruhigt das.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Eine Explosion, in die eine geheimnisvolle Frau verwickelt ist, der Watts nachgeht, führt Murdoch zu einer geheimen Gemeinschaft.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Die Entdeckung der Leiche eines jungen Mädchens, sowie einiger grotesker Zeichnungen, führt Murdoch zu dem Verdacht, dass eine Gruppe von Jugendlichen, die vom Tod besessen sind, dahintersteckt. Unter ihnen ist auch ein gewisser H. P. Lovecraft.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Der Tod einer professionellen Rollschuhläuferin wirkt zunächst wie ein Unfall. Bei seinen Ermittlungen stößt Murdoch auf Rivalitäten im Wettkampf und er findet sich alsbald in einer Welt von gnadenlos ehrgeizigen jungen Frauen wieder.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Nach politischen Intrigen wird Murdoch des Mordes verdächtigt und gerät selbst ins Visier der Polizei. Während seine Kollegen an seine Unschuld glauben, bleibt wenig Zeit, eine gefährliche Verschwörung aufzudecken.

programme.title: Mord in Genua - Ein Fall für Petra Delicato
programme.desc: Petra und Antonio müssen den Mord an einem Obdachlosen aufklären. Während der Ermittlungen werden zwei weitere Menschen aus seinem Umfeld tot aufgefunden. Wie hängen die Fälle zusammen? Eine Spur führt zur Stiftung des Unternehmers Adolfo.

programme.title: Magic Stocking - Magische Weihnachtszeit
programme.desc: Als eine junge Witwe bei einem Kunsthandwerksverkauf einen zerfetzten alten Weihnachtsstrumpf findet, entdeckt sie bald, dass dieser magische Kräfte besitzt.

programme.title: Lucky Christmas
programme.desc: Holly Ceroni, eine alleinerziehende Mutter, ist mit ihrem gesamten Leben unglücklich und wünscht sich bessere Zeiten. Gerade mit dem herannahenden Weihnachtsfest stellt sie sich die Frage, ob auch für sie wieder glücklichere Momente kommen werden. Als ihr Auto, in dem ein Gewinnlos der Lotterie liegt, gestohlen wird, will ihr Mike Ronowski helfen, Weihnachten wieder genießen zu können. Doch er hütet ein Geheimnis, welches alles verändern könnte.

programme.title: Mr. Miracle
programme.desc: Harry Mills ist ein Engel und wird für seine erste weihnachtliche Mission auf die Erde geschickt. Er soll der Studentin Addie Folsom bis Heiligabend dabei helfen, den Tod ihres Vaters zu verarbeiten, und ihr Leben wieder in den Griff zu bekommen. Diese Aufgabe erweist sich als schwieriger als gedacht, denn Harry lernt, dass Menschen anders sind, als er vermutet hatte. Somit lernt er viel über die Verhaltensweisen der Menschen.

programme.title: Grand Hotel
programme.desc: Alicia entkommt in der Vollmondnacht nur knapp dem Mörder mit dem goldenen Messer und Julio gerät unter Mordverdacht. Durch Javiers Verrat und die Schuldgefühle wegen des Sturzes ihrer Schwester wird Eugenia in Verzweiflung getrieben.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch untersucht den Mord an einem irischen Mädchen, als er eine Verschwörung aufdeckt, um einen britischen Prinzen zu töten. Murdoch muss sich einer fanatischen Gruppe stellen, die als "die Bruderschaft" berüchtigt ist.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries - Auf den Spuren mysteriöser Mordfälle
programme.desc: Murdoch untersucht den Tod eines Landbesitzers, der an einem Baum hängt, und entdeckt in der Nähe Spuren, die nicht von menschlichen Füßen stammen. Als auch Kornkreise auftauchen, muss er in Betracht ziehen, dass die Mörder Außerirdische sind.

programme.title: Cedar Cove - Das Gesetz des Herzens

programme.title: Mini Matinee
programme.desc: Vier entzückende Tiere spielen Theaterstücke in der magischen Theaterwelt. In jeder Folge reisen die Freunde in einen Teil der Welt und teilen faszinierende Geschichten und amüsante Fakten über die Traditionen und Bräuche ferner Kulturen.

programme.title: Beep Beep
programme.desc: Zwei Autos und eine Straße freunden sich miteinander an und erleben zusammen allerlei aufregende Situationen. Trucky ist dabei besonders verantwortungsbewusst, Voom Vam ist stets für ein Abenteuer bereit und Roady macht sich immerzu Sorgen.

programme.title: Lieder & Rhythmen
programme.desc: Die Sendung zeigt Kinderlieder, die jeder kennt als auch neue Lieder und energetische Rhythmen aus der ganzen Welt. Die lustigen und bunten Animationen laden die Kinder zum Mitsingen und Mittanzen ein und machen die eigenen vier Wände zur Party.

programme.desc: Zwei Dinosauriereier sind aus dem Dinosaurierbaby-Kindergarten verschwunden. Die Helden folgen der Spur der Eier, um sie zu finden und sicher in den Kindergarten zurückzubringen.

programme.title: Walter & Dude
programme.desc: Dude, der Hund, weiß nicht mehr, was er sucht. Zum Glück ist sein Freund Walter, die Maus, immer zur Stelle, um zu helfen. Die beiden Freunde beschreiben jedes Objekt und versuchen zu erraten, was es ist.

programme.title: Sounds of the Seventies
programme.sub-title: Disco: Ain't No Stopping Us Now
programme.desc: Disco was all pervasive in the mid and early 70s. And while towards the end of the decade punk stole the headlines, disco still had the high street. Everyone was into it and getting down on it at the local discotheque. Join us in a celebration of all things disco including performances by The Jacksons, Thelma Houston, Sylvester, Carl Douglas, George McCrae, Sister Sledge, McFadden and Whitehead, Eruption and Gloria Gaynor. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Travel back in time with a compilation of legendary performances of classic acts straight from the archive of one of the most popular music chart shows in history. Top of the Pops was broadcast weekly from 1964 until 2006, welcoming the greatest stars who performed their biggest hits. This special brings you unforgettable musical moments of pop and rock icons like The Rolling Stones, The Beatles, David Bowie, The Who, The Clash, Blur, Oasis and many more. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fungi: The Web of Life
programme.desc: Much of life on earth is connected by a vast, hidden network that we are only just beginning to understand. Out of sight, between the world of plants and animals, another realm exists – the kingdom of fungi. Passionate biologist and writer Merlin Sheldrake travels the globe, exploring the secret world of fungi. Through dazzling images of fungi under the microscope and all around us in the forest, Merlin unravels the many secrets of these essential organisms. So much more than mushrooms, not only do fungi shape the weather and support life on land, they are also at the cutting edge of medical research and even have the power to break down plastic waste. This film takes us from the ancient Tasmanian Tarkine rainforest to the mystical wilds of China's Yunnan Province, in search of solutions to some of our planet's biggest challenges. Can the answers be found in the wonderful world of fungi? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: An ambitious adventure of discovery awaits intrepid TV comedian-turned-global explorer Michael Palin, as he journeys around the Pacific rim to meet disparate communities which share a common coastline. This is his third great trek, having circumnavigated the world and traversed from North to South Poles in earlier series. Palin's personable character shines through as he makes new friends and learns about the culture and lifestyles of peoples who inhabit islands, archipelagos, shorelines and ocean-facing nations across the hemispheres. Setting out from Alaska, the ex-Python star visits Japan, Korea, China, Vietnam, the Philippines, Australia, New Zealand, Chile, Bolivia, Peru, Columbia, Mexico, the USA and Canada, before returning to his departure point. Get ready for a close-up view of volcanoes, rainforests and coral reefs, and a privileged insight into regional cuisines, cultural ceremonies and cities buzzing with entertainments and bristling with off-the-tourist route attractions. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fanny and Alexander
programme.desc: Uppsala im Jahr 1907: Die Geschwister Fanny (Pernilla Allwin) und Alexander (Bertil Guve), acht und zehn Jahre alt, werden durch den Tod des Vaters aus ihrer großbürgerlichen Idylle gerissen. Als Mutter Emilie wenig später den Bischof Vergérus heiratet, finden sich die Kinder plötzlich im kalten Haushalt eines heuchlerischen Tyrannen wieder…\r\nDer 1918 geborene Ingmar Bergman verwob seine eigenen Kindheitserinnerungen mit Fiktion zu einer großen Familiengeschichte und zum Porträt einer Epoche. Der Film gewann vier Oscars für den Besten fremdsprachigen Film, die Kamera, Ausstattung und Kostüme.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: A gentle sitcom set in the fictional village of Grantleigh, and the aristocratic family seat of the fforbes-Hamilitons. The widow of the deceased Lord of the Manor is Audrey, who inherits the Grantleigh Manor, which has been in her family for hundreds of years. But her husband's debts have left the estate bankrupt and Audrey has no option but to sell up. The new Lord of the Manor is Richard DeVere, a recently widowed self-made millionaire., whom Audrey is determined to pursue in a last-ditch bid to resurrect her title to the property. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: The story revolves around Hyacinth Bucket, a housewife from a lower class whose only aim in life is to impress others with her etiquette and social skills and climb the social ladder. She is terrified that her background will be revealed one day, and goes above and beyond to hide it. She insists her inharmonious surname is pronounced Bouquet. All her attempts as a rule lead to awkward comic situations, and the truth is revealed. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: On one of the wettest days in Roadshow history, over 2,000 visitors queue to see Fiona Bruce and the experts sheltering under the canopy at Minehead Station, which is run by West Somerset Railway. Objects brought to camera include a bracelet made from jewels once owned by the last of the Romanovs, the Russian royal family, photographs from the day The Beatles came to film A Hard Day's Night and a bronze by sculptor Rodin. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Stitch in Time
programme.desc: Documentary series that combines biography, art and the history of fashion as host Amber Butchart, a fashion historian, explores the lives of historical figures – Marie Antoinette, Charles II, Dido Belle, Edward the Black and others, by examining the clothes that they wore. Amber looks into the history of the garments and the people depicted, visiting collections and speaking with experts. Alongside Amber, historical tailor Ninya Mikhaila and her team recreate key garments using the original techniques. The viewers have a chance to see Amber wear the recreated clothing at the end of each episode. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village
Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius
programme.desc: Shakespeare's life and legacy is threatened when the Gunpowder Plot unearths a secret he has worked all his life to bury: his family are Catholics, traitors to the crown. When his daughter is implicated in the fallout, Shakespeare unleashes his most epic work to date: Macbeth, which appeals to the new monarch, King James I. As Shakespeare teeters towards death, he reflects on his successes and failures, questioning family, forgiveness and mortality as his work is at risk of being lost forever. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Peace in No Man's Land
programme.desc: The story of the Christmas truce On Christmas Eve 1914 on the Western Front, British and German soldiers sang carols to each other across a frosty, moonlit No Man's Land. The next morning, on Christmas Day, hundreds of men of both nations emerged from the trenches to talk, joke, take photographs and exchange souvenirs, in the most famous fraternisation of the First World War. This remarkable event is remembered by three soldiers who took part: Graham Williams of the London Rifle Brigade, Leslie Walkinton of the Queen's Westminster Rifles and Albert Moren of The Queen's Regiment. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Antiques valuation programme. A team of well-respected experts travel around the UK visiting a string of beautiful locations such as castles, stately homes, mansions, gardens and museums. They are met by members of the public who have brought along an antique, family heirloom or curio, eager for a current valuation. The experts have their own specialisms and are always on the lookout for a surprise discovery among the artwork, furniture, jewellery, silver, books, clothing and more. The entertainment comes from the conversations about the histories of the more interesting items, and the suspense as the owners and onlookers who gather around the stands await the experts' estimations about how much each would go for at auction. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Cookery programme full of mouth-watering food, great chefs and celebrity guests. Show typically includes a host chef and two guest chefs, each cooking in the studio. programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: Nigella continues to show us that what and how we cook really can make us feel better and more alive. She introduces us to her favourite recipes for sharing with family and friends. There's a pork bun feast, too. First inspired by a visit to a New York eatery, Nigella's succulent belly pork burgers – with their array of condiments and picky bits – are now a favourite DIY lunch when the hoards descend. programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Two teams of amateur collectors meet at an antiques fair to compete to turn in the largest profit from a £300 budget. The contestants first head to the High Street to acquire items they want to trade. Any leftover money is taken by their mentors, who go shopping for extra items as 'bonus buys'. The teams must decide which 'package' of goodies should be taken to auction, on the understanding that they may turn in a profit or loss on their investment decisions. The show has been on air since March 2000, being voted Most Popular Daytime Programme in 2002 and Best Lifestyle Show in 2003. programme.title: Film: The Iron Claw
programme.desc:
Profi-Wrestler Fritz Von Erich hat den Weltmeistergürtel nie erhalten. Also sollen seine Söhne Papas Traum leben. Der älteste Sohn starb tragisch im Kindesalter. Der zweitälteste, der breit gebaute Kevin, ist bereits auf gutem Weg und hat in der hübschen Pam die Liebe seines Lebens gefunden. 

Seinem Bruder David fehlen ein wenig die Muckis, dafür hat er immenses Showman-Charisma. Kerry ist eigentlich Diskuswerfer, doch als Präsident Jimmy Carter für US-Athleten die Teilnahme an den Olympischen Spielen in Russland verbietet, sattelt er für den Kampf im Ring um. Nur der jüngste Bruder Mike ist mehr an Musik als an Wrestling interessiert. Doch die streng religiösen Eltern drillen ihre Kinder mit harter Hand – bis eine Reihe von Tragödien die Familie nach und nach dahinrafft… 

Der Zerfall der Von Erichs verlief in den 80ern so schockierend, dass die wahren Ereignisse für den Film entschärft werden mussten – ansonsten wäre es kaum schaubar. Die Darsteller, vorneweg der krass aufgepumpte Zac Efron, brillieren in dieser White-Trash-Variation einer „König Lear“-Erzählung. Regisseur Sean Durkin inszeniert den körperlichen Extremsport, als handle es sich bei den Männern um unsterbliche griechische Titanen, die dann unsanft vom Schicksal wieder zu Sterblichen gemacht werden.

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: In recent years, our knowledge of life beneath the waves has been transformed. Using cutting-edge technology in this extended special we celebrate the highlights from the series. From the intense heat of the tropics to our planet's frozen poles, through to its unexplored depths, we reveal new worlds and extraordinary never-seen-before animal behaviours. Starting in the tropical coral reefs – the most diverse ocean habitat – a tusk fish demonstrates a surprising level of ingenuity – tool use – as it uses corals as an anvil to break open clams. In the Seychelles, half a million terns nest on an island. Fledglings must eventually take to the wing, but danger lurks beneath the waves: metre-long giant trevally fish leap clear out of the water to snatch birds on the wing. In the tropics sun heats the sea, creating rain, winds and huge storms that drive up towards higher latitudes. Here the seas change with the seasons. In spring thousands of mobula rays gather in Mexico's Sea of Cortez. At night, in a previously unseen event, tiny organisms that light up when disturbed react to their wingbeats, creating an enchanting bioluminescent firework display. The seasonal seas are home to bountiful kelp forests. In the undersea forests of southern Africa, one resident – the common octopus- has become the ultimate escape artist. To outwit her nemesis, the pyjama shark, she uses ingenious tactics, never filmed before. On the coast, two worlds collide. Where sea meets land, coasts are the most dynamic and challenging habitats in the ocean. The ever-changing tides create rock pools. But these temporary worlds are a battleground. Predatory starfish turn a magical garden into the stuff of nightmares. The big blue is the world's greatest wilderness – it's a vast marine desert where there is little to eat and nowhere to hide. Sometimes there is a brief explosion of food in this marine desert, but ocean hunters must be fast to make the best of this bonanza. We witness super-pods of up to five thousand spinner dolphins racing to herd vast shoals of lanternfish, briefly caught at the surface where it is thought they spawn. New aerial footage reveals, for the first time, the spectacular feeding frenzy of 90kg tuna and dolphins smashing through the lantern fish shoals turning the sea white with foam. The deep is perhaps the most hostile environment on Earth, at least to us – a world of crushing pressure, brutal cold and utter darkness. We have barely begun to explore it and yet it is the largest living space on our blue planet, home to strange worlds like methane volcanoes and undersea lakes of salty brine. But life adapts in ingenious ways, like the sea toad – a fish that walks instead of swims. And barrel-eye – a deep sea fish with a translucent skull so that it can see through the top of its head to make the most of any glimmer of light. The deep is more closely connected to our own world than we ever thought possible due to giant ocean currents. We join these ocean currents as they begin their lives in Antarctica and flow from the poles to the tropics and back again, linking every ocean. Ocean currents move heat around our planet and maintain a climate favourable for life. But our ocean system, in relative equilibrium for millennia, is changing at a worrying rate. Deep in the polar north, we meet walrus mothers and their newborn calves, searching for an ice floe to rest on; but with rising temperatures, summer sea ice is retreating- their battles to survive are becoming ever harder. As we begin to understand the true complexity of the lives of our ocean creatures so do we recognise the fragility of their home. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Discover more about the British countryside as the presenters visit rural homes and areas to bring stories about nature and wildlife and environmental topics to a wider audience. The programme focuses on seasonal subjects with an overarching theme of conservation, species protection, the preservation of the rural way of life and challenges facing modern farming communities. The Sunday morning show has been presented by John Craven since its launch, and features competitions, interviews, studio debates and market reports. Special productions include bird species census counts, with members of the public taking part in surveys, and tips for farmers, conservationists, ramblers and nature lovers alike. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The warm, sunlit waters of the tropics support the greatest diversity of life in the ocean. Bathed in year-round sunlight for millions of years, these seas are home to more species than anywhere else on earth. In a world where competition is fierce, animals have evolved extraordinary ways to survive. Yet even in these seemingly familiar waters, remarkable new behaviours are still being discovered. At the northern tip of Australia, a tawny nurse shark patrols the shallows in search of food. Too slow to chase fish in open water, it relies on a surprising strategy. Gathering in groups, the sharks appear to work together in a coordinated ambush. After waiting patiently in the shallows, they drive huge shoals of fish out of the water and onto the beach before vacuuming up their prey by the mouthful. Further west, Shark Bay is home to one of the world's greatest concentrations of dolphins. Here, bottlenose dolphins have developed a hunting technique previously unknown to science. Carrying sea sponges to isolated coral bommies, they use them to block the hiding places of fish, creating one of the most sophisticated examples of trap-setting ever documented in the animal kingdom. Across the tropics, coral reefs are bustling underwater cities where predators and prey are locked in a constant battle. In the Red Sea, coral groupers communicate with two very different hunting partners – giant Maori wrasse and sleek moray eels. Only by working together can they flush prey from the reef's maze of crevices, making the grouper far more successful than it could ever be alone. After dark in Bali, the reefs take a more sinister turn as harlequin shrimp stalk starfish for supper. Barely five centimetres long, these tiny hunters have developed a macabre way of overcoming prey many times their size. Beyond the reefs lie immense plains of sand and mud. Here, humpback whales arrive after epic migrations from Antarctica. For one female, this will be her final journey. As she takes her last breath, hundreds of sharks gather nearby. In death, her body becomes a vital source of nutrients, feeding a host of scavengers and bringing life to one of the tropical seas' most barren landscapes. Far out to sea lies Fernando de Noronha, a remote volcanic island in the equatorial Atlantic. Here, hundreds of green turtles gather to graze on lush seaweed. Their abundance attracts one of the tropics' most formidable predators: the tiger shark. Yet turtles are far from defenceless, combining surprising agility with nature's most effective armour. In the seagrass meadows, dugongs spend up to ten hours a day grazing, cultivating an unexpected following. Remoras hitch a ride and feed on parasites, dead skin and even the nutrient-rich waste left in their wake. Among tangled mangrove roots, one of the planet's most effective carbon-storing habitats, male fiddler crabs risk their lives for a chance to mate, dodging the probing bills of hungry scarlet ibis before the tide returns. There are some special places on earth where all these tropical habitats converge, like in the Coral Triangle of Asia. Here, a clownfish family depends on a single sea anemone for survival. When an unprecedented marine heatwave causes both corals and anemones to bleach, the fish fight to save their home. By cleaning away debris and helping oxygenate their host, they do everything they can to keep it alive until cooler waters return. But the tropical seas are changing. Across the tropics, many reefs are struggling to recover from increasingly frequent marine heatwaves. As scientists race to understand and protect these extraordinary ecosystems, the tropical seas remain a world of ingenuity and wonder, where every habitat reveals a new and surprising story of survival. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show
programme.desc: Graham Norton plays host to his celebrity guests, who are invited to chat, play games and give an insider view on stories that grab the public's attention, especially within the world of entertainment. International stars of the calibre of Tom Cruise, Tom Hanks and Will Smith have joined in the fun, but whether the guests are top league or minor list celebs, the interview couch is never short of a little star voltage, or a cheeky story or two to keep viewers enthralled. The critics have awarded Graham with the gold standard of talk shows, and there's nothing that he is not prepared to discuss with his VIP interviewees. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Weather for the Week Ahead
programme.desc: Detailed weather report. Bringing you details of current weather conditions for across the UK and what to expect for the next seven days. With forecasts, temperatures and weather warnings. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: BBC One's flagship morning current affairs programme with news headlines and regular weather reports. Start your day with the biggest national and international stories. Breakfast takes a look at the day's papers and brings you the latest developments in sports, politics, business and entertainment. Breakfast welcomes guests to the studio for a chat. Whilst analysis and special reports offer a greater understanding of important subjects. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: A stone's throw from today's antiques fair in West Sussex is a 500-acre wild botanic garden with an exquisite Elizabethan mansion at its centre. Natasha Raskin Sharp takes a break from the hustle and bustle of the fair to visit Kew Wakehurst and learn of its long history. The mansion's roof has just been restored, and inside Natasha meets one of the curators to find out about several objects recently uncovered that tell of this grand house's story. Over the fence, niece and aunt Abby and Della take on dad and daughter Sonal and Ruhi on a sweep of the antiques stalls, with experts Caroline Hawley and Thomas Forrester in tow. With a few buys under their belts, the reds recline on a pair of furry blue armchairs, but the punchy price tag means they don't stop for long. The blues also have furniture on their minds when Ruhi spots an occasional table – made from a tree trunk. In Chichester, the teams plan to grow a profit when Nick Hall takes to the rostrum. Caroline hopes her bonus buy will bring Abby and Della good luck, while Thomas aims to spread the love with his. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: Early afternoon round-up of the day's biggest national and international stories. The BBC News Team bring you the headlines and essential up-to-the-minute information about the latest developments. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Sarah Moore is at Witley recycling centre in Surrey on a mission to save three items with the potential to be revamped and sold on for cash. She finds a drinks trolley for designer Ayo Daramola-Martin and an old wind-up gramophone for signwriter Joel Poole. For her own project, Sarah has a collection of lampshades to get creative with – but will all three skip finds produce profits for their unsuspecting owners? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Interesting docu-reality show, hosted by English actor and presenter Nigel Havers, in which a panel of dealers provide expert advice and buy off various antique and collectable items brought in by members of the public. Nigel welcomes people who have intriguing, often peculiar and extraordinary items they want to sell- anything from toys and furniture to musical instruments, and introduces them to an expert who provides them with some information about the object. Sellers then go to the ''Bidding room'' where they meet five dealers who have to bid against each other if they want to take home these incredible items. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Ian, Kate, Paul and Suzy – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lee finds an undiscovered Banksy and attempts to steal the artwork in a foolhardy quest for fame and fortune. When he is collared by a security guard, however, he panics and hints that he might be Banksy to get away. Now, he finds himself at the centre of a blackmail plot. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: While playing baseball, Weasy hits a ball out of bounds. It lands on a scary scarecrow, which frightens the ducklings. Weasy makes fun of them, but he's scared, too! He leaves without the ball but refuses to admit that he's afraid. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings: World Tour.
Stage Stars
programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, the Year 7s have been told about the school ghost and set off to hunt for it. Meanwhile, the Anything Goes cast try not to get too spooked by the thought of opening night for their show, and Encore – the most senior dancers at the school – warm up for their next big show. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the growing season draws to a close, it's time to catch up with Adam Frost in his new garden – and he's been busy. The base of the greenhouse is now in, and there's turf to lay, soft fruit to get in the ground and a shady border to plant up. In the Peak District, Rekha Mistry offers up some more timely advice on how to grow veg in pots, while Rachel de Thame heads to Nottinghamshire to revel in that autumn stalwart, the hardy chrysanthemum. The wonderful world of Japanese maples comes under the spotlight as a mother and daughter share their love of these beautiful trees. And Advolly Richmond delves into the colourful history behind the gardens at Blenheim Palace. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden.
programme.desc: Marcus steps things up with a hunt for the perfect cow. He heads to Shropshire in search of a rare breed that has been around in England for centuries, the English Longhorn. A close encounter with a bull isn't enough to put him off after he tastes the delicious product. Back on the farm, he harvests his own horseradish before developing a special recipe for horseradish sauce. While some goes in the cupboard, much of it forms Marcus's contribution to a sharing event with the local community down at the village pub. And once the new Longhorns are in place, it's time for a special celebration meal with beef at its very heart. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: With the assistance of her daughter Maryam, Nadiya shares go-to family bakes that are as foolproof and fuss-free as they are delicious. First up, Nadiya and Maryam, a self-confessed 'flapjack fanatic', share their ultimate recipe for this classic family favourite. The quick and effortless recipe features sweet, sticky oats sandwiching a secret layer of sharp raspberry jam and smothered in a triple chocolate topping. Next, Nadiya turns the simple sandwich into a family feast with her triple-stack tandoori naan sandwich. It features succulent tandoori chicken breast wedged between three layers of soft naan and smothered in minty mayo, crisp apple cabbage and crunchy poppadoms. Then, Nadiya's spicing up a boring mid-week meal with her punchy Mexican one-pot wonder. This twist on chilli nachos, with gently spiced minced beef loaded with crunchy tortilla strips, rich oozy cheese, and topped with fresh jalapenos, is designed to put the fun back into family meals in one easy bake. Last up is an epic chocolate cookie pie, with a deep filling of chocolate hazelnut spread and crispy wafers encased in a chewy chocolate chip cookie dough pie crust. With minimal effort, this extraordinary bake caters for 16 people. Meanwhile, baker Louise Nicholson shares her colourful vegan bakes, such as her signature Highland cow and unicorn cupcake, that have taken Edinburgh by storm. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Sense And Sensibility
programme.desc:
England, spätes 18. Jahrhundert. Nach dem Tod des Gatten rutschen Mrs. Dashwood und ihre Töchter Marianne (Kate Winslet), Elinor (Emma Thompson) und Margaret die soziale Leiter hinunter. Elinor, die Edward (Hugh Grant) liebt, kann sich nun diese gute Partie aus dem Kopf schlagen. 

Auch die romantische Marianne muss erleben, wie sich ihr Favorit John (Greg Wise) des Geldes wegen mit einer anderen verlobt. Kann Colonel Brandon (Alan Rickman) sie jetzt erobern?

Bilder wie Gemälde, brillante Darsteller, dazu ein Oscar-gekröntes Drehbuch von Emma Thompson – ein wunderbares Frühwerk von Ang Lee („Life of Pi“).

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Four familiar faces paired with a friend or a loved one leave their luxury lifestyles at the starting line for a journey that will take them to the other side of the world and push them to the limits of their endurance. The pairs embark on a life-changing adventure – a 7,500km race from the prehistoric jungles of Borneo to the sun-baked southern tip of Australia. Competing in this series are acclaimed singer-songwriter and musician Sam Ryder, and his best friend and tour manager, Kaz; veteran sports broadcaster Jeff Stelling and his son Matt; BRIT award-winning singer-songwriter Ella Eyre and childhood friend Nana; and influencer Princess Andre with her brother musician Junior Andre. Stripped of their smartphones and bank cards, these household names will be tested; emotions will run high, and relationships will be transformed on an adventure that's as challenging as it is rewarding. They will need to rely on their own resourcefulness and the kindness of strangers to reach the finish line, equipped with only a map and a budget of £26 each a day. Their race begins in Kuching, a vibrant city in north west Malaysian Borneo and the gateway to the island's vast wilderness. From there, the teams must cross three countries and two continents, weaving through five checkpoints before reaching the finish line in Melbourne, Australia. The teams must tackle the most formidable race yet – traversing the ancient jungles and indigenous heartlands of Borneo, navigating the Makassar Strait to Sulawesi, an island of cinematic, towering limestone cliffs, before reaching the kaleidoscopic splendour of Queensland's landscapes, from the turquoise blues of the Great Barrier Reef to the arid, expansive orange of the outback. Finally, they will thread through sprawling Sydney before reaching the finish line on the southern tip of Australia. Musician Sam and tour manager Kaz embrace an unexpected start to the race and dive straight in, relishing the chance to revisit the early days of their friendship when roughing it on tour was the norm. They undertake a jungle adventure, heading inland to connect with the indigenous Tae people. First-time backpackers Princess and Junior have shared a childhood in the public eye, making their sibling bond incredibly strong, but find themselves in at the deep end when trying to navigate the winding streets of the Sarawak capital. Keen to make the most of the adventure, they choose to spend time in Malaysia, putting in a shift at a family-run coconut farm in Mount Kuwai. Ella and best friend Nana bonded at school but now live countries apart. Hoping the race will reunite them, they embrace village life in West Kalimantan and are welcomed into a traditional Dayak longhouse. But with erratic public transport running through the remote rainforest, the pair face a nerve-racking dilemma. Determined to keep up with the youngest of the teams but the most cautious of the pairs, Jeff and his son Matt face an early test to their relationship as they get off to a faltering start. They manage to escape the intense equatorial heat by opting for water travel down the coast through the meandering river delta. As the series unfolds, the teams have to make it through some of the toughest legs the race has ever seen. Famous faces are tested like never before, relationships strengthen, and countless memories are made in jaw-dropping locations. The race starts now... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: The Battle Of Britain
programme.desc:
Im Sommer 1940 hat Hitler den Alliierten auf dem Kontinent empfindliche Niederlagen zugefügt. Als Konsequenz setzt Marshal Dowding (Laurence Olivier) durch, dass sich England auf die Heimatverteidigung konzentriert und keine Flugzeuge über den Ärmelkanal sendet.

Obwohl der Feind viermal mehr Flugzeuge zur Verfügung hat, weigern sich die Briten, die Kapitulationsforderung von Baron von Richter (Curd Jürgens) anzunehmen. Am 10. August 1940 folgt das Unvermeidbare: Deutsche Stukas greifen die englischen Stellungen an, um die Royal Air Force bereits am Boden kampfunfähig zu machen. 

16 Wochen lang versuchen die Nazis, das Inselreich in die Knie zu zwingen. Schließlich kommt es im Luftraum über London und dem Kanal zu einigen der entscheidenden Schlachten des Zweiten Weltkriegs. Im Angesicht einer drohenden Niederlage wachsen die alliierten Piloten über sich hinaus…

Die überragenden Luftkämpfe und die opulente Ausstattung entschädigen für schablonenhafte Personenzeichnungen. Bond-Produzent Harry Saltzman stopfte 12 Millionen US-Dollar in den Film. Da fast alles für alte Flugzeuge und Stunts draufging, hinkt die Story hinterher.

programme.title: Serie A: AC Milan v Inter Milan
TOTP: Big Hits 1996
programme.desc: Relive some of the biggest hits of 1996 with these Top of the Pops classic performances. Summer hits were aplenty with Peter Andre, Gina G and Los Del Rio all bringing sunshine to Elstree. Hooks in hip-hop proved dominant with Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Mark Morrison, Toni Braxton and the Fugees all scoring huge hits. Britpop was still booming, with Oasis continuing to dominate singles sales with Sleeper hot on their heels. Global dance classics were born courtesy of Faithless and Robert Miles, and add into the mix the awesome arrival of Spice Girls, plus many more, and it's not a year to miss. Artists featured include Spice Girls, Suede, The Fugees, Babylon Zoo, Beautiful South, Mark Morrison, Sleeper, Los Del Rio, Peter Andre, Alanis Morrisette, Manics, Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Robret Miles, Space, OMC, Garbage, Gina G, Kula Shaker, Toni Braxton, Babybird and Oasis. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Oasis – Live at Manchester City Stadium.
programme.desc: Oasis, one of the world's biggest touring bands pulls out all the stops during their 2005 world tour. Following the release of a sixth studio album, they return to their hometown of Manchester for a triumphant concert at the City of Manchester Stadium. The performance includes Lyla, Songbird, The Importance of Being Idle, Live Forever, Don't Look Back in Anger, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Rock 'n' Roll Star and a raucous version of The Who's classic anthem My Generation. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: The Porthcawl crew's training night is disrupted when a call comes from a dog walker who has spotted a surfer in trouble below the cliffs at nearby Rest Bay. During the peak of a cyclone known as Storm Amy, Bridlington's lifeboat is tasked to a Dutch trawler that has lost power 13 miles off the Yorkshire coast. In Ireland, an urgent call comes in to the Crosshaven crew from a yacht taking part in a local race; on board, an elderly sailor is reported to have broken his leg. The Calshot crew face a tense search in thick fog for a motorboat with engine failure – somewhere in the busy shipping lanes of the Solent. And reports of a submerged car in the Thames put the Chiswick crew on red alert. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Countryfile Ramble for BBC Children in Need 2026.
programme.desc: In this year's Countryfile Ramble for BBC Children in Need, Matt Baker, Anita Rani, Margherita Taylor, Joe Crowley and John Craven lace up their walking boots to meet inspirational young people whose lives have been transformed through support from BBC Children in Need. The ramble is returning for its 12th year, set against the stunning backdrop of the Peak District. The presenters walk alongside five remarkable young people who have faced significant challenges, hearing first-hand how BBC Children in Need-funded projects have helped them build confidence, resilience and hope for the future. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie is in Aberdeenshire, visiting Scotland's first inclusive farm, built by a blind farmer who is determined to make agriculture accessible for all. Arlene sails to Jura to see how the locals cope with the huge deer population and find new outlets for venison. Anne discovers how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. And Shahbaz is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Best of Weatherman Walking: Welsh Islands.
programme.desc: Derek is island-hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island – a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds – where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island, where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, Derek heads up north to Wales's largest island, Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and a sauna on a beach. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt dishes up a feast of food from the Saturday Kitchen archives to whet the appetite for the week ahead. The Hairy Bikers bring comfort food bang up to date with sticky Szechuan lamb, stuffed into pillowy soft bao buns, with a fresh hit of pickled carrots, spring onion and herbs – cosy comfort with a fragrant Asian twist! Meera Sodha introduces a taste of Sri Lanka to the studio as she continues the comfort theme with her warming lentil and coconut dal with crispy mustard kale. Jeremy Lee brings his effervescent charm and wit to the kitchen whilst giving an underused cut of meat its chance in the spotlight. He makes a rich steamed kid pudding that melts in the mouth. Mary McCartney celebrates Bonfire Night with her flavour-packed smoky dogs, while Carmen O'Neal and Idris Elba team up to serve a masterclass in brandy. And queen of puddings Nigella Lawson tucks into either her food heaven, scallops, or her food hell, candied fruit. Meanwhile, Rick Stein explores the New Forest's bounty of produce, and the Hairy Bikers make a Menorcan dish in the Mediterranean Sea. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match. In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means 'to brew') and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt's restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for Best Bakes Ever. Each episode gives baking fans another chance to experience classic dishes from the likes of the James Martin, Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo. There's added insight and appreciation from Jane herself too. Whether its cakes, pies, puddings or main courses – this greatest hits of baking is a must for anyone with a need to knead, and should help inspire even more of us to start getting creative in the kitchen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MOTD Live: Women's Super League: Charlton Athletic v Chelsea.
Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin introduces a collection of the best finds from the show's travels to Lulworth Castle in Dorset, Chiddingstone Castle in Kent, and Wrest Park in Bedfordshire. The antiques experts include Catherine Southon, Christina Trevanion, Adam Partridge, Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, with items ranging from a cloisonne vase to an astonishing collection of First World War slides. Paul also finds out more about the ancient art of shipbuilding at Buckler's Hard in Hampshire. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: For a live demonstration of terroir, Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Standing on one side of a road, owner Jeremy Seysses points to a parcel of grand cru (the very best) of Clos de la Roche. On the other side is a premier cru (the next best) – a Gevrey-Chambertin Combottes. Back at the winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch. Despite the grapes being grown just a few metres away, these reds are a class apart. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wild Horses, the Rockies and Me
programme.desc: As summer comes to a close, wildlife film-maker Gordon Buchanan ventures deep into the epic majesty of Canada's Rocky Mountains in search of one of nature's most iconic animals: wild horses. Powerful, dangerous and elusive, wild horses are icons of the untamed west, yet they are surprisingly overlooked by science, and their lives remain largely undocumented. As a keen rider in his youth, Gordon aims to change that. Set against the stunning peaks, open grasslands and shadowy pine forests that fringe the eastern slopes of the Rockies, Gordon rides out on his own steed hoping to get to places only a wild horse can reach. After a series of setbacks, he eventually finds a family of so-called wildies that consists of two competing stallions, two mares and their two young foals, and starts bearing witness to their behaviour. Which of the two stallions, Red or Crusoe, is the father of the foals, and who will earn the right to lead the band? What motivates Red to keep the band separated away from the super-herd that gathers each day? Would it not be wiser to join up with other horses to guard against ravenous grizzly bears and wolves looking to fatten up for winter? Will the innocence and curiosity of the two foals, Socks and Boots, get them into trouble? To understand more about the horses, and in particular this unusual family, Gordon immerses himself further into their world, attempting to befriend them and hoping to earn their trust as he seeks to experience their lives from within a herd of wild horses, something that hasn't been attempted before. Gordon must move carefully and think like a wild horse. However, this is not without its dangers, as one well-placed kick could be fatal, meaning he must learn to read the subtle language of flicking ears, stamping hooves and quiet glances that reveal what the horses are telling each other about him, uncovering their complex intelligence and close family bonds. As he begins to gain acceptance into the herd, Gordon discovers that they face a greater danger than wild predators: the threat of being culled. He realises the devastating impact this would have on family groups, as well as on the fragile ecosystems they help to shape. Getting closer than expected to this living symbol of the west's untamed history could change how he feels about horses forever. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC Young Musician 2026: The Final
programme.desc: From hundreds of entries, just three talented, young classical musicians remain as BBC Young Musician reaches its thrilling finale. This competition has launched the careers of some of the biggest stars in classical music, including Nicola Benedetti, Alison Balsom and Sheku Kanneh-Mason. At the end of the evening, another exceptional musician will be crowned to follow in their footsteps. The final is the ultimate test for the three remaining players as they perform a full concerto with a professional orchestra in front of a packed auditorium at Bristol Beacon. We follow their progress during rehearsals and find out exactly what it takes to perform at this level. Accompanying our finalists is the BBC National Orchestra of Wales, with internationally renowned conductor Alpesh Chauhan. Petroc Trelawny brings us exclusive backstage access and full performances from the evening. Returning to the jury are our series judges, critically acclaimed pianist Joanna MacGregor and award-winning conductor Ben Gernon. For the exciting finale, they are joined on the judging panel by Errollyn Wallen, the celebrated composer and current Master of the King's Music. Only they can decide who will be named BBC Young Musician 2026. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing.
programme.desc: Paul and Bob are back in Norfolk – a bittersweet return, as this was the very first location where Ted joined them. They both reminisce about Ted and raise a cup in his memory – although Ted would have preferred a biscuit. They head to some prime Norfolk lakes, hoping to catch a bream. It's been well documented that Bob is not a fan of the bream, but will a big catch make him change his tune? It's Paul and Bob's birthday week, and they consider whether they may celebrate any further milestones or simply let them pass. Bob ends up throwing a surprise 70s-themed birthday party for Paul on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Irish film star Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Away from the fairways, a traditional rambling house takes Bill outside his comfort zone as he explores Ireland's rich storytelling traditions. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts – and staying on the sidelines proves impossible. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Later
programme.desc: Jools welcomes north London rapper Skepta, who returns 11 years after his iconic debut performance on the show. Skepta performs a couple of tracks from his forthcoming album The Fork and Knife, including recent single Innocent Smile, which sees him join forces with Suggs from Madness in what is surely the collaboration of the year. Jools also chats to Skepta about the new album and the influence of his family, and they look back at his debut performance on the show of Shutdown in 2015. From New Zealand, singer-songwriter and musician Jordan Rakei performs two songs from his forthcoming seventh album A Safe Place to Be Wild, described as 'an intimate, surreal and emotionally direct record about self-acceptance, vulnerability and creative freedom'. From London, indie stalwarts Bloc Party return to the show with two performances from their recent Top 10 album Anatomy of a Brief Romance, a memoir in 14 songs which frontman Kele Okereke has described as some of the most personal songs he's ever written. From Hampshire and Pembrokeshire, sibling duo Johnny and Lillie Flynn, who are both actors and musicians, perform the song The Music of the Spheres, taken from their album Beam Cottage – inspired by the folk, acoustic and traditional music they grew up with and named after their childhood home – 'an idyll of happiness and togetherness before life began to feel more complicated'. Glasgow's corto.alto, led by multi-instrumentalist producer, composer and performer Liam Shortall, perform a track from their highly anticipated new album SOME SMALL FORTUNE, which sees 'each track...artfully layered and strikingly different from the last, yet they all cohere in the joyous sound world of Shortall's imagination'. From Los Angeles, singer-songwriter and film producer Rita Wilson performs a song with Jools from her latest album Sound of a Woman, described as an 'impassioned suite of songs that follow the arc of a woman's life, charting all the triumphs and missteps and unseen turning points leading to the radical awakening of full-fledged womanhood'. Jools and Rita also chat at the piano about the new album and how she recorded it in the same Nashville studio that Dolly Parton recorded Jolene and I Will Always Love You. Also appearing in this series are Jamie T, Violet Grohl, Emily Bear, Antony Szmierek, Leo Sayer and Tia Gordon. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc:
Bis zuletzt blieb die sonore Grimmigkeit und die schwarze Klamotte sein Markenzeichen. Doch Johnny Cash war alles andere als ein von Musikmanagern geformtes Image. Herr seiner selbst war er allerdings auch irgendwie nie. Schicksalsschläge – der geliebte Bruder starb früh bei einem Unfall –, die Gefühlskälte des Vaters, Drogensucht und vor allem die jahrelange unerfüllte Liebe zur Musikern June Carter machten sein Leben zur rastlosen Achterbahnfahrt. 

„Walk the Line“ zeigt das in für das Genre typischen, etwas atemlos episodenhaften Szenenfolgen, die bereits mit dem legendären Konzert enden, das Cash 1968 vor den Sträflingen des Folsom State Prison gab. Trotz der konventionellen Machart gibt der Film – allerdings nicht sonderlich tiefen – Einblick in eine von ständiger Pein geplagten Seele. 

Was vor allem dem eindringlichen Spiel von Joaquin Phoenix und Reese Witherspoon, die ihre zahlreichen Songs selbst singen, zu verdanken ist. Wie diese beiden sich über Jahre becircen und bekriegen ist eine der seltsamsten und aufregendsten Liebesgeschichten des Kinos. Und das Schönste: Sie ist wahr.

programme.title: Signed: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: A routine driving lesson takes a bizarre, surreal turn; a game show called Find the Snakes is destined to sweep the nation; contemporary politicians are introduced to a literal public arena; vape sommeliers treat e-liquid profiles with the gravity of a fine Bordeaux; two ultra-wealthy girls are determined to get exactly what they want; and two restaurant-goers take their love of food to an intense extreme. Featuring an appearance from Asim Chaudry. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Question Time
programme.sub-title: Has the Budget Avoided Big Decisions?
programme.desc: Following this week's Labour Budget, Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Warwick. On the panel are chief secretary to the treasury, Labour's Emma Reynolds MP; Conservative James Cartlidge MP; Liberal Democrat Daisy Cooper MP; Reform UK's Zia Yusuf; and podcaster and author Alastair Campbell. They debate the Budget, Brexit and debt from student loans. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Les Dennis, Jenny Eclair, Owain Wyn Evans and Lauren Patel take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The warm, sunlit waters of the tropics support the greatest diversity of life in the ocean. Bathed in year-round sunlight for millions of years, these seas are home to more species than anywhere else on earth. In a world where competition is fierce, animals have evolved extraordinary ways to survive. Yet even in these seemingly familiar waters, remarkable new behaviours are still being discovered. At the northern tip of Australia, a tawny nurse shark patrols the shallows in search of food. Too slow to chase fish in open water, it relies on a surprising strategy. Gathering in groups, the sharks appear to work together in a coordinated ambush. After waiting patiently in the shallows, they drive huge shoals of fish out of the water and onto the beach before vacuuming up their prey by the mouthful. Further west, Shark Bay is home to one of the world's greatest concentrations of dolphins. Here, bottlenose dolphins have developed a hunting technique previously unknown to science. Carrying sea sponges to isolated coral bommies, they use them to block the hiding places of fish, creating one of the most sophisticated examples of trap-setting ever documented in the animal kingdom. Across the tropics, coral reefs are bustling underwater cities where predators and prey are locked in a constant battle. In the Red Sea, coral groupers communicate with two very different hunting partners – giant Maori wrasse and sleek moray eels. Only by working together can they flush prey from the reef's maze of crevices, making the grouper far more successful than it could ever be alone. After dark in Bali, the reefs take a more sinister turn as harlequin shrimp stalk starfish for supper. Barely five centimetres long, these tiny hunters have developed a macabre way of overcoming prey many times their size. Beyond the reefs lie immense plains of sand and mud. Here, humpback whales arrive after epic migrations from Antarctica. For one female, this will be her final journey. As she takes her last breath, hundreds of sharks gather nearby. In death, her body becomes a vital source of nutrients, feeding a host of scavengers and bringing life to one of the tropical seas' most barren landscapes. Far out to sea lies Fernando de Noronha, a remote volcanic island in the equatorial Atlantic. Here, hundreds of green turtles gather to graze on lush seaweed. Their abundance attracts one of the tropics' most formidable predators: the tiger shark. Yet turtles are far from defenceless, combining surprising agility with nature's most effective armour. In the seagrass meadows, dugongs spend up to ten hours a day grazing, cultivating an unexpected following. Remoras hitch a ride and feed on parasites, dead skin and even the nutrient-rich waste left in their wake. Among tangled mangrove roots, one of the planet's most effective carbon-storing habitats, male fiddler crabs risk their lives for a chance to mate, dodging the probing bills of hungry scarlet ibis before the tide returns. There are some special places on earth where all these tropical habitats converge, like in the Coral Triangle of Asia. Here, a clownfish family depends on a single sea anemone for survival. When an unprecedented marine heatwave causes both corals and anemones to bleach, the fish fight to save their home. By cleaning away debris and helping oxygenate their host, they do everything they can to keep it alive until cooler waters return. But the tropical seas are changing. Across the tropics, many reefs are struggling to recover from increasingly frequent marine heatwaves. As scientists race to understand and protect these extraordinary ecosystems, the tropical seas remain a world of ingenuity and wonder, where every habitat reveals a new and surprising story of survival. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize. Who will swipe their way to victory? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman explore Cockermouth's food festival, meeting passionate food producers and getting tips on homemade pitta bread from a MasterChef winner. Cookery writer Michaela Chiappa discovers how seaweed is being harvested for food, and chef Julie Lin gets the low down on low-fat, semi-skimmed and full-fat milk. Chef Suzie Lee reveals how top chefs are getting creative as they reduce food waste. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: An epic stretch of Scottish coastline is the first stop for Michael Portillo as he begins a series of coastal railway journeys around the British Isles. Siccar Point, close to Dunbar on the Firth of Forth, was the site of an extraordinary 18th-century discovery and is today a place of pilgrimage for earth scientists from across the world. Michael finds out how James Hutton's Unconformity upended biblical teaching about the age of the earth. From North Berwick, Michael takes a boat a mile out into the Firth to visit one of the wildlife wonders of the world, a volcanic island known as Bass Rock. Long since abandoned by humans, it is now a breeding ground for 150,000 northern gannets. Standing with his seabird centre guide and with the white-and-yellow birds nesting and courting only feet away, Michael has to pinch himself to believe the scene. Next stop is the Scottish capital, Edinburgh. Arriving at Britain's second largest station, Waverley, Michael walks out into the Old Town with its castle and palace linked by the Royal Mile. He climbs to the city's highest point, Arthur's Seat, for a paleontologist's story of settlement in the region from 7,000 years ago. Neither she nor Michael will forget the name of her favourite fossil, which is tattooed on her fingers. At Holyrood House, the Queen's official residence in Scotland, Michael visits the scene of a grisly 16th-century murder, which was the stuff of myth in his childhood. Mary Queen of Scots' secretary, David Rizzio, was murdered by her husband and fellow lords in front of Mary in her private apartments. The palace building, its location and the historical events that took place within its walls help Michael to understand how royal power continues to be asserted in Scotland. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Secrets of the Aquarium
programme.sub-title: Do You Have Room for a Turtle?
programme.desc: Marcus and Emma head to the Maldives on a rescue mission for an injured turtle. Back in Plymouth, Ian trains Zeus the zebra shark using a toy boat, and Andrew collects fresh seaweed for Larry the lobster. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head to Ipswich, where among the treasures they find are a duke's chamber pot now used to drink champagne from, one of the earliest record players, and a 50p find on a white elephant stall which turns out to be worth much more. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mr Magoo
programme.desc: Grappige animatiereeks over een behulpzaam maar slechtziend mannetje dat alles in het honderd laat lopen. Het grootste slachtoffer daarvan is Fizz, de megalomane hamster. Nederlandstalige versie (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Monster shaker
programme.desc: Justin wilt absoluut op zijn computer een spelletje spelen met zijn vrienden. Maar hij veroorzaakt per ongeluk een kortsluiting in het hele huis. Hij roept het monster Helderster op om energie te produceren. Helaas werkt Helderster enkel als er spanning tussen mensen is. Daarom doet Justin er alles aan om zijn zus kwaad op hem te krijgen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mega Maffe Monsterfreaks
programme.desc: Een grappige avontuurlijke monsterreeks die kinderen stimuleert tot fantasie, tolerantie, oog voor diversiteit en creativiteit. Drie kinderen worden door hun stoere oude opa opgeleid tot monsterjagers. Er is alleen één probleem. Deze kinderen zijn enorme monsterfans. Waarom zouden ze op hun monsteridolen willen jagen? Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Monster Loving Maniacs') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Lou
programme.desc: Animatiereeks over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou en haar vrienden die op de drempel van de adolescentie staan. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van Julien Neel. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Lou!') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dodo
programme.desc: Animatiereeks over de belevenissen van de 11-jarige Joe Connolly die in het eerste jaar van de middelbare school zit. Nederlandstalige versie (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Zotte dieren
programme.desc: Liveactionreeks waarin Gary, de vloggende hond de grappigste dierenclips laat zien. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Silly Animals') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Nederlandse fictiereeks over de eigenzinnige Floor en haar gedachtes. Want In Floors wereld bedenken kinderen, net als volwassenen, hun eigen regels en dat leidt tot bijzondere inzichten. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige boekenreeks van Marjon Hoffman. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Zee in zicht
programme.sub-title: *** Titel der Episode noch nicht bekannt ***
programme.desc: Nona en Karen spreken af met Bram Cuyx van het VLIZ. Bram weet alles – maar dan ook álles – over de geluiden die de zee maakt. En dat zijn er heel wat! Van vissen over schepen tot zelfs garnaaltjes, de zee is een kakofonie van lawaai! En misschien horen ze ook wel een monster? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grizzy & the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grappige animatiereeks over de beer Grizzy, wiens rustige leven grondig verstoord wordt door een groep vervelende lemmings – op avontuur in het Amazonegebied (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Pedro richt een klaslokaal in als een vipruimte die enkel toegankelijk is voor rijke leerlingen. Maar Pedro breidt de privileges voor de rijken snel uit. Zo mogen enkel zij nog les volgen in de klaslokalen. De arme leerlingen moeten de lessen buiten voor het raam volgen. Soekie leidt het verzet tegen deze ongelijkheid. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De Hoppers
programme.desc: Arno baalt dat hij weeral moet studeren. Hij zou zo graag rijk zijn, dan moet hij niet meer naar school en nooit nog huiswerk maken. Wanneer hij op een ochtend wakker wordt, hebben Jackie en Geert goed nieuws voor Arno. Hij heeft de lotto gewonnen. Arno's grote droom is eindelijk uitgekomen. Hij is rijk en hoeft niet meer naar school. Maar is dat wel echt zo leuk als hij dacht? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: United
programme.sub-title: Ferre beslist om te stoppen met voetballen
programme.desc: Hannes en Xander trainen samen. Dat moet geheim blijven voor de teamgenoten van Hannes. Door zijn autisme, raakt Ferre overprikkeld en reageert hij fel tegen de groep. Zijn vrienden weten niet dat hij autisme heeft en reageren onbegripvol. Ferre besluit om te stoppen met voetballen. (Senderinfo).
